gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le writes with ink strokes that taper out before they touch, while Amatic SC up top stays a rustic, wiry line. Approachable text, easy to settle into.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tc: Large open counters make Noto Sans TC feel generous, its curves opening outward instead of curling in. And Amatic SC, with strokes like a bent steel rod, adds a quirky handwritten voice on top.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Amatic SC draws every letter with a flat, unmodulated stroke, quirky and rustic, like a casual hand-lettered sign. Noto Sans Telugu is the steadier text voice.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Noto Sans Thai Looped looks bold in the lowercase because its bodies are so tall, with spacious gaps at curve terminals. Noto Sans Thai Looped suits a modest size beside the rustic, single-width strokes of Amatic SC.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC has a pipe-cleaner feel in every letterform. And Noto Sans Tifinagh fills each line with rounded, inflated bowls that stay open and inviting beneath it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta reads contemporary and clean, with a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave a big gap. But Amatic SC brings a rustic hand, every letter built from one width of stroke.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Vithkuqi opens the throats of a, c, e and s. Amatic SC then adds a quirky, handwritten heading whose n arches are as thick as the stems beside them.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-yi: Wiry and rustic, Amatic SC carries the weight of a drawn wire. Noto Sans Yi follows with a deep midsection and unsealed rounds, modern and unhurried across many paragraphs.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Rustic wire letters meet a tall, open text face. Amatic SC has a rounded-wire quality, and Noto Sans Zanabazar Square, with its soaring x-height and crisp gaps, feels friendly and contemporary beside it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Quirky handwriting over broad-nibbed calm. Amatic SC does casual, rustic charm best, while Noto Traditional Nushu does approachable text best, its pen strokes never curling shut and its bowls filling the line.
